title: FREQUENCY ignores non-numeric data (even direct scalars), ignores errors in bins_array, and falls back to {0} when no numeric bin exists
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, FREQUENCY(data_array, bins_array) ignores non-numeric values in data_array even when supplied as direct scalars (while propagating errors in data_array), ignores both non-numbers and errors in bins_array, supplies a single {0} bin when bins_array yields no numbers (e.g. FREQUENCY(data, "2") counts values <= 0 and > 0), and returns a (bins.len() + 1) x 1 column where repeated bins record their count in the first occurrence and 0 in later copies. Matches 1,520/1,520 full-bank FREQUENCY rows.
basis: Measured across all 1,520 full-bank FREQUENCY rows in Excel 16.0.20527 (CalcFunc-Evidence bank2-answers-frequency-{spill,variants}.json) and prefix_metadata (row 91).
